```{r}
#| label: libraries
source("packages.R")
tar_source()
```

```{r}
#| label: load-targets
tar_load(
  c(toads,
    toads_states,
    toads_west_front,
    toad_distances)
)
```

```{r}
toads
```


```{r}
toads_states |> count(state)
toads_states |> count(point_in_state)
toads_states |> count(state, point_in_state)
toads |> count(decade)
ggplot(toad_distances, aes(x = decade, y = distance_km)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(width = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: front
toads_west_front |>
  select(decade, lon, lat, state, point_in_state)
```
